PM-KISAN

A central sector scheme of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.

Benefits

Under the scheme an income support of Rs. 6,000 per year is provided to all landholding farmer families, in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 every four months.

Eligibility

  • All landholding farmer families, who have cultivable land in their names, are eligible.

Exclusion Criteria

  • All institutional landholders.
  • Farmer families in which members paid income tax in the last assessment year.

Documents required

  • Aadhaar card
  • Land holding papers
  • Bank account details

How to apply

  1. Farmers can register through the New Farmer Registration option on the PM-KISAN portal.
  2. Registration can also be done at Common Service Centres or through the State nodal officer.
